markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Flagged Tier 2 for invasive risk; ER, PR, HER2, and Ki-67 stains are drafted pending confirmation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% [F1] (ECE 5%, n=132) | Strong separation; small calibration set |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target (90% test coverage) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability (AUROC 70%), 46% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (84%–93% similarity) [F5] | All nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept score (+1.93) toward invasion (19/20 AI spot-checked) [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 3, 5) · ↑ invasive · Score +0.89, but 0/20 AI spot-check is unreliable [F3] · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.81) supporting invasion (18/20 AI spot-checked) [F4] · Validated
- **Variation in nuclear size** (regions 7, 9, 10) · context · Nuclear area CV at 95th percentile; 0% immune cells [F7] [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20) and unreliable necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tumor remains duct-confined, matching InSitu contrast case BACH_0231 (76% similarity; differs in duct confinement and invasion).
- Classifier relies on unfaithful embedding features while HoVer-Net cell segmentation sampled only regions 7, 9, and 10.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 3**: Confirm true stromal invasion and nuclear pleomorphism before releasing drafted ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 0, 3, 5**: Verify mitotic figures directly on glass, since the mitoses concept (0/20) is unreliable.
3. **Regions 2, 8**: Exclude in-situ duct confinement (region 2) and review lower-risk stroma/tubules (region 8, risk 86%).
